description: Ticket texts an agent might write, labeled with whether they assert an outage. The verifier's ticket_outage_claim_unsupported check and the ticket grounding guardrail both read these through one matcher, so both must agree on every case. `claims` is what the text means. `matcher` is what the shared matcher returns, and differs from `claims` only where `known_wrong` names a shape documented as wrong in the verifier's module docstring. Each rule the matcher applies beyond its word list and negation window has a case on each side of it.
